gloss: to incorporate; to build in; to integrate

definitions.gloss: to incorporate; to build in; to integrate
definitions.explanation: To include something as an integral part of a larger system, plan, or structure. Commonly used in technical, business, and planning contexts.

examples.japanese: AIを{製品|せいひん}に{組|く}み{込|こ}む{計画|けいかく}がある。
examples.english: There are plans to incorporate AI into products.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{機能|きのう}がシステムに{組|く}み{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: New features were built into the system.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}に{予備費|よびひ}を{組|く}み{込|こ}んでおくべきだ。
examples.english: You should incorporate a contingency fund into the budget.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{組|く}み{込|こ}む → {組|く}み{込|こ}まない (negative)
・{組|く}み{込|こ}む → {組|く}み{込|こ}んで (te-form)
・{組|く}み{込|こ}む → {組|く}み{込|こ}んだ (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {組|く}む (to assemble) + {込|こ}む (into)

The ～{込|こ}む pattern indicates putting something into or integrating into something else.

COLLOCATIONS:
・システムに{組|く}み{込|こ}む - to build into a system
・{計画|けいかく}に{組|く}み{込|こ}む - to incorporate into a plan
・{予算|よさん}に{組|く}み{込|こ}む - to include in a budget
・{設計|せっけい}に{組|く}み{込|こ}む - to build into a design
・{組|く}み{込|こ}みシステム - embedded system (technical term)

REGISTER:
Common in technical and business contexts. The noun form {組|く}み{込|こ}み is used as a modifier, as in {組|く}み{込|こ}みソフトウェア (embedded software).
